WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
    END as signed_amount,
    balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE amount > 2400
),
account_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(signed_amount) as avg_signed,
    AVG(balance) as avg_balance,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN signed_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as signed_count
  FROM filtered_trans
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN signed_count > 0 THEN avg_signed END),
  AVG(avg_balance)
FROM account_averages
